name: United Development Company Q.P.S.C.
summary: United Development Company Q.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, contributes and invests in infrastructure and utilities in the State of Qatar. The company operates through Urban Development, Hospitality and Leisure, Infrastructure and Utilities, Educational services, Healthcare, and Other Operations segments. It engages in the real estate development and construction activities. The company is also involved in the investment and development of hotel and leisure facilities; selling of luxurious items; construction and management of district cooling systems and marina activities; provision of information technology solution and other services; environment related businesses; and business …
